summary: Corrected the prior session's wrong 'settings.json merge routine is broken' diagnosis. Real root cause (independently verified): the events hook registrations were added only to the install-once root-files/settings.json, never to merge-sources/settings-hooks.json (the file the merge step actually reads) -- the merge itself was never defective. Fixed at source: added PostToolUse/events-log-artifact.sh, Stop/events-log-lifecycle.sh, and a new SubagentStop key/events-log-lifecycle.sh to merge-sources/settings-hooks.json, each a dedicated single-command matcher object. Verified via jq/grep/check-extension-docs.sh. No deployment occurred; Phases 5-6 remain [PARTIAL]; task terminus remains [PARTIAL].

blockers.description: merge-sources/settings-hooks.json now correctly declares the three events hook registrations, but this is a source-store-only fix. No deployed .claude/settings.json (nvim or ~/.dotfiles) has been updated -- a fresh <leader>al 'Sync all (replace existing)' regeneration is still required, and there is no headless/CI path to trigger it (execute_sync is a module-local closure gated behind an unconditional vim.fn.confirm()).

The pre-existing duplicate claude-stop-notify.sh Stop-matcher entry in the already-deployed .claude/settings.json (both repos) cannot be resolved by any future merge -- merge.lua's deep_merge dedups at whole-matcher-object granularity via vim.deep_equal and is add-only, never removing an existing entry.

Zero PostToolUse-artifact events and zero genuine Stop/SubagentStop-hook-driven session events exist anywhere in specs/events.jsonl in either repo, a direct consequence of the still-undeployed Phase 5 fix. Only the pre-existing preflight/postflight lifecycle channel is confirmed flowing.

The underlying defect -- install-once root-files (settings.json/settings.local.json) can never self-heal a missed addition once a target repo already exists, and merge.lua's dedup is add-only at object granularity -- lives in lua/neotex/plugins/ai/shared/extensions/loader.lua and merge.lua, under lua/**, outside this task family's agent-system/extensions/**-only edit scope.

decisions_made: Diagnosed and corrected the prior session's wrong root-cause framing ('settings.json merge routine is broken'): the merge step was never defective, it merged an input (merge-sources/settings-hooks.json) that never declared the events hooks.

Added the three missing hook registrations as their own dedicated single-command matcher objects rather than appending into existing shared matchers, to remain idempotent under merge.lua's whole-object vim.deep_equal dedup across repeated future merges.

Left the pre-existing duplicate claude-stop-notify.sh Stop-matcher entry untouched in merge-sources/settings-hooks.json -- removing it was outside this dispatch's explicit scope (recorded as a separate blocker/follow-up, not attempted).

Did not run the Stage 5a blanket 'repair stale phase headings to [COMPLETED]' backstop, because Phase 5 and Phase 6 are deliberately [PARTIAL] (gated on a manual regeneration and on real usage over time, respectively) -- mechanically flipping them to [COMPLETED] would have violated the explicit no-overclaiming constraint for this dispatch.
